Embedding request with multiple inputs returns multiple embedding objects

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\EmbeddingRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\EmbeddingRequest::from_json(json_encode(["input" => ["Hello world", "Goodbye world"], "model" => "text-embedding-3-small"]));
$result = LiterLlm::embed($req);
var_dump($result->getData());
var_dump($result->getData()[0]->index);
var_dump($result->getData()[1]->index);
```
